name: Lynette
title: Elegance in the Shadows
description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

skills.name: Rapid Ritesword
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Enigmatic Feint
skills.description:
Flicks her mantle and executes an Enigma Thrust, dealing Anemo DMG.
When the Enigma Thrust hits an opponent, it will restore Lynette's HP based on her Max HP, and in the 4s afterward, she will lose a certain amount of HP per second.
Based on whether you Press
She swiftly uses an Enigma Thrust.

Hold
Lynette will enter a high-speed Pilfering Shadow state and apply Shadowsign to a nearby opponent. You can control her movement direction during this state, and you can end it prematurely by using this skill again.
When this high-speed state ends, Lynette will unleash her Enigma Thrust. If there is an opponent with Shadowsign applied to them nearby, Lynette will approach them in a flash before using Enigma Thrust.

A maximum of 1 opponent can have Shadowsign at any one time. When this opponent gets too far from Lynette, the Shadowsign will be canceled.

Arkhe: Ousia
At specific intervals, Lynette will unleash a Surging Blade when she uses Enigma Thrust, dealing Ousia-aligned Anemo DMG.
skills.info: "Now then, turn your eyes to the stage and continue to enjoy the performance. When I next appear, I'll be where you least expect."

skills.name: Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift
skills.description:
Lynette raises her mantle high, dealing AoE Anemo DMG, using skillful sleight of hand to make a giant Bogglecat Box appear!

Bogglecat Box
·Taunts nearby opponents, attracting their attacks.
·Deals Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at intervals.
·When the Bogglecat Box comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will gain the corresponding element and additionally fire Vivid Shots that will deal DMG from that element at intervals.
Elemental Absorption of this kind will only occur once during this ability's duration.
skills.info: "Look this way, and look closely. This is a time for miracles, just for us."

passives.name: Sophisticated Synergy
passives.description: Within 10s after using Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift, when there are 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types in the party, all party members' ATK will be increased by 8%/12%/16%/20% respectively.

passives.name: Props Positively Prepped
passives.description: After the Bogglecat Box summoned by Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift performs Elemental Conversion, Lynette's Elemental Burst will deal 15% more DMG. This effect will persist until the Bogglecat Box's duration ends.

passives.name: Loci-Based Mnemonics
passives.description: Shows the location of nearby Recovery Orbs on the minimap. The Aquatic Stamina and HP gained from touching Orbs will be increased by 25%.

constellations.name: A Cold Blade Like a Shadow
constellations.description: When Enigmatic Feint's Enigma Thrust hits an opponent with Shadowsign, a vortex will be created at that opponent's position that will pull nearby opponents in.

constellations.name: Endless Mysteries
constellations.description: Whenever the Bogglecat Box summoned by Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift fires a Vivid Shot, it will fire an extra Vivid Shot.

constellations.name: Cognition-Inverting Gaze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Magic Trick: Astonishing Shift by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Obscuring Ambiguity
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Enigmatic Feint by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Watchful Eye
constellations.description: When Lynette uses Enigmatic Feint's Enigma Thrust, she will gain an Anemo Infusion and 20% Anemo DMG Bonus for 6s.

outfits.name: Phantomeow
outfits.description: Lynette's outfit. A cat resides in the shadows until it wishes to show itself — inscrutable, just like a magician's assistant.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. I am Lyney's magic assistant, and if you have work-related inquiries, please ask Lyney. If you have questions related to seeing a magic show, please ask the ticket office. You want to talk to me? ...Then get to the point.

voices.title: Chat: Drinking Tea
voices.text: Tea is ready, now it's time for a short rest.

voices.title: Chat: Older Brother
voices.text: Seems Lyney is saying some strange things again... it's really worrying.

voices.title: Chat: Spacing Out
voices.text: Entering Standby Mode... I hope nobody disturbs me.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Rainy days are perfect for spacing out...

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: The skies have cleared? What a pity.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Ow... that hurts my ears.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: So cold... let's hide you in a hat!

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: There is nothing new under the sun... Is that really true?

voices.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voices.text: *sniff* What's that on the breeze? ...Nope, it's nothing.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning... Not fully recharged. Now snoozing again.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I usually drink a cup of tea before work. Not only does it change my mood, but also helps me stay alert.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: After the sun goes down, the desires hidden in people's hearts will rise to the surface... I mean, evening shows are spectacular. Should I reserve a ticket for you?

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Go to sleep, I still have some loose ends to tie up from work today... (I still have to fix the vacuum cleaner I broke.)

voices.title: About Lynette: Magic
voices.text: During our shows, I'm usually Lyney's assistant. Because I never speak or change expressions, people often mistake me for a puppet... this kind of misunderstanding can prevent unnecessary social interactions, so it's actually quite nice.

voices.title: About Lynette: Intelligence Reports
voices.text: Staying silent is beneficial for maintaining focus and gathering intelligence. Once, a VIP audience member at our show took out a handkerchief that didn't belong to his wife... as for how such information is used, now... that depends on what "Father" wants.

voices.title: About Us: Listening
voices.text: I'm not accustomed to expressing myself, but I consider myself a good listener. If you have any troubles, come find me. I'll guard your secrets.

voices.title: About Us: Interests
voices.text: I used to think that the golden sun and dark shadows of the night could never understand one another. But in you, I see a kind of strange complexity that has needlessly piqued my curiosity... I'll have to keep a close eye on you.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: I prefer to use my eyes to understand the situation and find an appropriate solution, as opposed to using martial prowess. But having brute force as an option greatly increases the potential cards at your disposal, and enables you to protect those most important to you in a crisis.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Making tea looks simple on the surface, but it is actually quite complex. The quality of the tea leaves, the temperature of the water, the number of times to add water... Only when every variable is properly controlled can tea of the purest taste be brewed. Would you like a cup?

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Animals can also express their feelings. If you listen carefully, you can tell what state they are in. For a kitty, "Meow~" means they are much happier than "Meow meow meow!", and in that situation, you can pet them as much as you want and they won't run away.

voices.title: About Lyney: Unspoken Understanding
voices.text: I have always been together with Lyney, and we can tell what the other is thinking without speaking. Thus, he tends to be more quiet than normal when we are alone. Hmm? Can I tell when he's lying or telling the truth? Of course I can, but this matter is top secret.

voices.title: About Lyney: Worries
voices.text: Lyney is normally quite confident, and does everything with incredible ease... or at least, that's how he wants everyone else to see him. So when he runs into difficulties, he always wants to solve everything perfectly on his own... if this happens, please be sure to take good care of him.

voices.title: About Freminet
voices.text: He is a delicate and gentle child, but also tends to belittle himself... perhaps due to his previous experiences. Sometimes he feels like the antithesis of Lyney... but since they're both family, when their opinions clash, I will bridge their differences.

voices.title: About "Father"
voices.text: Oh, how "Father" expresses love... well, not everyone can accept it. But it is only because of "Father" that home... can be called home.

voices.title: About Neuvillette
voices.text: The Chief Justice always feels strangely aloof, though his words are always humble... or perhaps he just doesn't like dealing with humans? After all, when he speaks with Melusines, he's actually quite friendly.

voices.title: About Furina
voices.text: Lady Furina's behavior is incredibly hard to explain, and I can't discern any useful intelligence from observing her. I always feel like her every move and action is an act, and she is playing different people... She truly is an Archon, one cannot apply the logic of ordinary humans to her.

voices.title: About Navia
voices.text: Though she's the new president of Spina di Rosula, her style is more like the nosy big sister next door. If we really had a sister like her in the "House of the Hearth," that would be really great... I know I probably shouldn't be wishing for anyone to be an orphan, but...

voices.title: About Clorinde
voices.text: I was once ordered to observe a duel of hers. Even just as a bystander, the coldness radiating from her was absolutely chilling... I don't know what it would be like to face her directly in a duel, and I hope I will never find out.

voices.title: About Chiori
voices.text: The costumes Lyney and I wear for performances were specially tailored by Chiori. Once, Lyney was using a small knife for a magic trick, and accidentally cut the cuff of his sleeve a bit. She scolded us nonstop... it was scary. Luckily, I can hide behind Lyney whenever we go to her shop.

voices.title: About Charlotte
voices.text: Uh... I was eventually cornered by her for interviews a few times. The way she persistently asked even after Lyney rejected her all those times, I really have to commend her perseverance. Too bad for her, though... despite preparing all those questions, I never answered a single one.

voices.title: About Emilie
voices.text: Her perfume products are so popular that you have to get in line before the break of dawn to have a chance at snapping any up. However, I'm far too sensitive to the smell of perfume, and it's really rude to sneeze... so I have to take the long way around.

voices.title: About Escoffier
voices.text: Hmm... I saw her tail wagging today. Must mean the new confection she came up with is a keeper. I'm looking forward trying it at the next tea party.

voices.title: More About Lynette: I
voices.text: If you explain a magic trick, then the allure of the performance is lost. Personal relationships are the same. If you want to understand me, why not learn a bit at a time, and gradually piece together a complete picture?

voices.title: More About Lynette: II
voices.text: Humans are complicated creatures. Even when they are not doing so intentionally, they will still unconsciously hide their true selves. Though I can always notice a few "redundant" details, I won't expose their facades when it isn't necessary.

voices.title: More About Lynette: III
voices.text: Magic shows were once our livelihood, but now they are more of a convenient identity to present to society. In the name of magic performances, we can easily gain more access throughout the city, and be the "eyes" of our House.

voices.title: More About Lynette: IV
voices.text: Before Lyney and I came to our new home, we were constantly adrift on the streets. We experienced many hardships and dangerous situations... It was then that I developed the habit of paying attention to any sign of danger, and also gradually learned to understand what others were thinking. Fortunately, we now have a safe place to live.

voices.title: More About Lynette: V
voices.text: Building a relationship with someone is like gambling. No matter how much information you have, it's hard to predict how other people might change. I've always had the habit of keeping a safe distance from others, but in your case... I'm willing to shoulder the risk of losing a bet.

voices.title: Lynette's Hobbies
voices.text: A person's mental state is like a bowstring. If it's constantly under high tension, it will be at risk of suddenly snapping. So outside of work, I prefer to do things that relax my brain, like making tea, feeding cats, and just zoning out. The calmer one normally is, the easier it is to deal with crises when they do pop up.

voices.title: Lynette's Troubles
voices.text: I tend to have difficulties operating any kind of machinery. As soon as I stop paying attention, all kinds of things start to go wrong. Once, I even broke the dryer on a rainy day... At least Freminet is good at fixing things.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Pry open the shells, squeeze a bit of lemon juice onto the fresh shellfish... no plate necessary. Perfection.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: Dishes should not be over-seasoned. Good food preserves the original taste of the ingredients.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Delicious. I've already memorized the recipe.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Thank you for your generosity.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Perhaps you could reconsider the spice ratio a bit?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy Birthday! Let me give you this card... it's not a greeting card, so of course nothing's written on it. Write down what kind of present you want, place it in my hat, and no matter what it might be, you'll get it.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: My perception has been heightened.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: My processing speed... has become even faster.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: I can see the conditions for victory now.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I never imagined I could become this powerful... looks like I won't need to hide behind you anymore.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Step on up!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Over here.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Surprise!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Let the magic begin!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Cue the spotlight!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Be amazed!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: The scent of treasure.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Just as I expected.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Piece of cake!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: Stay calm.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: I need to focus.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Entering Combat Mode...

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Take a bow!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Let me take the heat!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: What detail... did I miss...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Saw through... my trick...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Lyney...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: I'll live!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ah, didn't quite dodge it.

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Is it time for a magic show?

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Time for afternoon tea.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: You lead the way.
